lines.text: Jesus sees a large crowd and orders a crossing to the other side of the sea, and a scribe offers to follow Him.
Jesus tells the scribe that foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
Another disciple asks to first bury his mother, but Jesus tells him to follow Him and let the dead bury their own dead.
Jesus gets into the boat and a violent storm engulfs it, but He is praying until the disciples wake Him.
Jesus rebukes the winds and the sea, the sea becomes perfectly calm, and the amazed men ask what kind of man He is.
